salt_pct.quote: > At 6 wk. the moisture content of Buyens' cheese averaged between 43 and 44 per cent, the pH was 5.3 to 5.4 and the salt content was between 2.0 and 2.5 per cent.

ammonia.reason: Surface Brevibacterium/Corynebacterium deamination deacidifies to pH 5.3-5.4 releasing NH3.

animal_barnyard.reason: Washed-rind coryneforms and yeasts produce p-cresol, phenols and indolic barnyard notes.

bitter.reason: Rennet and starter proteolysis leaves hydrophobic peptides, balanced by washing.

blue_moldy.reason: No Penicillium roqueforti inoculation and no methyl ketone blue pathway.

browning.reason: Moderate residual lactose/lysine and pH ~5.25 gives good Maillard browning on heating.

buttery.reason: Lactococcus lactis citrate metabolism yields diacetyl/acetoin in washed low-acid curd.

cheesy_sweaty.reason: Moderate total FFA ~2150 mg/kg with lipolysis releasing butanoic/hexanoic sweaty acids.

creaminess.reason: 41% moisture, ~30% fat and washed-curd demineralization give smooth creamy mouthfeel.

crumbliness.reason: Elastic washed-rind paste with intact para-casein network, not dry-crumbly.

firmness.reason: Semi-soft 41-44% moisture, 2-month rind-formed block sliceable but yielding.

fruity.reason: Surface yeast and Brevibacterium esterase forms ethyl butanoate/hexanoate.

goaty.reason: Cow milk lacks high branched-chain goat fatty acids 4-methyloctanoic/4-ethyloctanoic.

malty_nutty.reason: Leucine/isoleucine Strecker aldehydes 3-methylbutanal plus pyrazines from rind flora.

melt.reason: pH 5.25, 2% salt, washed curd calcium loss allows good flow without pasta-filata.

mushroom_earthy.reason: Limited 1-octen-3-ol/1-octen-3-one; light Geotrichum/yeast earthiness on rind.

oil_off.reason: 29.7% fat age-weakened emulsion releases moderate free oil on melting.

smoky.reason: Unsmoked make with no wood-smoke phenols/guaiacol.

sour_vinegar.reason: Lactic/acetic acid at pH 5.25; sweet-curd never below pH 5.1, mild tang.

stretch.reason: Non-filata rennet gel, no hot-water stretching, only slight warm elasticity.

sulfur_cooked.reason: Pasteurized milk low H2S/methanethiol; light methionine catabolism by rind bacteria.

sweet.reason: Washed curd removes lactose/acid, leaving lactose-free sweet diacetyl/lactones impression.

umami.reason: 2-month proteolysis releases glutamate and savory kokumi peptides.
